entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ ، عَنِ الْعَيْزَارِ بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «عَجِبْتُ مِنْ قَضَاءِ اللَّهِ لِلْمُؤْمِنِ، إِنْ نَابَهُ خَيْرٌ حَمِدَ رَبَّهُ وَشَكَرَ، وَإِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ مُصِيبَةٌ حَمِدَ رَبَّهُ وَصَبَرَ، وَالْمُؤْمِنُ يُؤْجَرُ فِي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَتَّى فِي اللُّقْمَةِ يَرْفَعُهَا إِلَى فِي امْرَأَتِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad b. Ibrahim al-Dawraqi narrated to us: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Mahdi narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from al-'Ayzar b. Hurayth, from 'Umar b. Sa'd, from his father, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "I marvel at God's decree for the believer: if good befalls him he praises his Lord and gives thanks; and if a calamity strikes him he praises his Lord and is patient. The believer is rewarded in everything, even in the morsel he raises to his wife's mouth."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 130
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَيَّانَ ، عَنْ مُجَمِّعٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ لِعُمَرَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ إِلَى أَبِيهِ حَاجَةٌ، فَقَدَّمَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ حَاجَتِهِ كَلَامًا مِمَّا يُحَدِّثُ النَّاسَ وَيَقُولُونَ: لَمْ يَكُنْ سَمِعَهُ مِنْهُ فِيمَا مَضَى، فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ قَالَ لَهُ: يَا بُنَيَّ قَدْ فَرَغْتَ مِنْ كَلَامِكَ؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: مَا كُنْتَ مِنْ حَاجَتِكَ أَبْعَدَ، وَلَا أَنَا فِيكَ أَزْهَدَ مِنِّي مُنْذُ سَمِعْتُ كَلَامَكَ هَذَا، سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: «يَكُونُ قَوْمٌ يَأْكُلُونَ بِأَلْسِنَتِهِمْ كَمَا تَأْكُلُ الْبَقَرَةُ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us: Ya'la b. 'Ubayd narrated to us: Abu Hayyan narrated to us, from Mujammi', who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Umar b. Sa'd had a need to put to his father, and before his request he put forward some talk of the sort people relate, which they said he had not been heard to say before. When he finished, [Sa'd] said to him: "My son, have you finished your speech?" He said: "Yes." He said: "You have never been further from your need, nor have I ever been more uninterested in you, than since I heard this speech of yours. I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: 'There will be people who eat with their tongues as the cow eats from the earth.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 132
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى ، أَخْبَرَنَا بَدْرُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ حَفْصٍ ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنَّا يَوْمًا عُوَّادًا لِسَعْدِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ أَوْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ - فَقَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ: بَدْرٌ الَّذِي يَشُكُّ - فِي مَرْضَةٍ مَرِضَهَا فَكُنَّا جُلُوسًا عِنْدَهُ وَهُوَ يُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ، فَتَذَاكَرْنَا الشَّهِيدَ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةِ، فَقَالَ بَعْضُنَا: مَا نَرَاهُ إِلَّا مَنْ خَرَجَ بِبَدَنِهِ وَسِلَاحِهِ وَنَفَقَتِهِ فَقَاتَلَ حَتَّى قُتِلَ، فَأَقْبَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَنَحْنُ فِي ذَلِكَ فَسَمِعَ بَعْضَ مَا كُنَّا فِيهِ، وَأَمْسَكْنَا حِينَ رَأَيْنَاهُ، فَجَلَسَ وَسَأَلَ بِالْمَرِيضِ، ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْنَا، فَقَالَ: «مَا الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ تَخُوضُونَ فِيهِ آنِفًا؟» فَأَخْبَرُوهُ فَقَالَ: «إِنَّ شُهَدَاءَ أُمَّتِي إِذًا لَقَلِيلٌ، يُسْتَشْهَدُ بِالْقَتْلِ وَالطَّاعُونِ وَالْغَرِقِ وَالْبَطْنِ وَمَوْتِ الْمَرْأَةِ جُمْعًا - مَوْتُهَا فِي نِفَاسِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us: 'Ubayd Allah b. Musa narrated to us: Badr b. 'Uthman informed us, from Abu Bakr b. Hafs, from 'Umar b. Sa'd, from Sa'd, who said:
entries.matn_en: One day we were visitors to Sa'd b. Mu'adh – or Mu'adh b. Jabal; 'Ubayd Allah said: it is Badr who is in doubt [about which] – during an illness he suffered. We were sitting with him as he kept losing consciousness, and we discussed the martyr of this community. Some of us said: "We consider the martyr to be only one who goes out with his body, his weapon and his provisions, and fights until he is killed." The Messenger of God ﷺ came while we were engaged in this, and heard some of what we were saying, and we fell silent when we saw him. He sat down and asked after the sick man, then turned to us and said: "What were you just discussing?" They told him, and he said: "Then the martyrs of my community are few indeed. One is made a martyr by being killed, by plague, by drowning, by [disease of] the belly, and by the death of a woman in childbirth (jum') – her death in her postpartum bleeding (nifas)."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 133
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ الْقَيْسِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا كَثِيرُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنِ الْمُطَّلِبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ جَاءَهُ ابْنُهُ فَقَالَ: أَعِنْ هَذَا فَقَدْ حَصَرَهُ قَوْمُكَ - وَعُثْمَانُ مَحْصُورٌ فِي دَارِهِ - فَقَالَ: أَيْ بُنَيَّ فِي الْفِتْنَةِ تَأْمُرُنِي أَنْ أَكُونَ رَأْسًا لَا وَاللَّهِ حَتَّى أُعْطَى سَيْفًا إِنْ ضَرَبْتُ بِهِ مُؤْمِنًا نَبَا عَنْهُ، وَإِنْ ضَرَبْتُ بِهِ كَافِرًا قَتَلَهُ، سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْغَنِيَّ الْخَفِيَّ التَّقِيَّ»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us: Abu 'Amir al-Qaysi narrated to us: Kathir b. Zayd narrated to us, from al-Muttalib b. 'Abd Allah, from 'Umar b. Sa'd, from his father,
entries.matn_en: that his son came to him and said: "Help this man, for your people have besieged him" – 'Uthman being besieged in his house. He said: "My son, are you telling me, in a time of trial (fitna), to be a leader? No, by God, not until I am given a sword which, if I strike a believer with it, glances off him, and if I strike an unbeliever with it, kills him. I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: 'God loves the self-sufficient, unobtrusive, God-fearing [servant].'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 134
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ لَبِيبَةَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: خَرَجَ عُمَرُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ إِلَى سَعْدٍ فَقَالَ - وَهُوَ بِالْعَقِيقِ -: إِنَّكَ الْيَوْمَ بَقِيَّةُ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَقَدْ شَهِدْتَ بَدْرًا وَلَمْ يَبْقَ فِيهِمْ أَحَدٌ غَيْرُكَ وَإِنَّمَا هُوَ مُعَاوِيَةُ فَلَوْ أَنَّكَ أَبْدَيْتَ لِلنَّاسِ نَفْسَكَ وَدَعْوَتَهُمْ إِلَى الْحَقِّ لَمْ يَتَخَلَّفْ عَنْكَ أَحَدٌ، فَقَالَ سَعْدٌ: أَقْعُدُ حَتَّى إذا لَمْ يَبْقَ مِنْ عُمْرِي إِلَّا ظَمَأُ الدَّابَّةِ أَضْرِبُ النَّاسَ بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ، إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: «خَيْرُ الرِّزْقِ مَا يَكْفِي وَخَيْرُ الذِّكْرِ مَا خَفِيَ»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us: 'Ubayd Allah b. Musa narrated to us: Usama b. Zayd informed us, from Muhammad b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. Labiba, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Umar b. Sa'd went out to Sa'd and said – he being at al-'Aqiq: "You are today the last of the Companions of the Messenger of God ﷺ; you witnessed Badr, and none of them remains but you; and there is only Mu'awiya. If you were to show yourself to the people and call them to the truth, no one would hold back from you." Sa'd said: "I will stay seated; [for should I,] when nothing remains of my life but the span of a beast's thirst, set people to striking one another? I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: 'The best provision is what suffices, and the best remembrance is what is concealed.'"

sections.title_en: Ibrahim b. Sa'd, from his father

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 136
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ يُحَدِّثُ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ لِعَلِيٍّ: «أَمَا تَرْضَى أَنْ تَكُونَ مِنِّي بِمَنْزِلَةِ هَارُونَ مِنْ مُوسَى»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us: Abu Dawud narrated to us: Shu'ba informed us, from Sa'd b. Ibrahim, who said: I heard Ibrahim b. Sa'd narrate from his father
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ said to 'Ali: "Are you not pleased to be to me as Aaron was to Moses?"

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 136
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النَّضْرِ هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، حَدَّثَنِي سَعْدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ
entries.matn_ar: بِمِثْلِهِ
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us: Abu l-Nadr Hashim b. al-Qasim narrated to us: Shu'ba narrated to us: Sa'd b. Ibrahim narrated to me, from Ibrahim b. Sa'd b. Malik, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ
entries.matn_en: likewise.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 137
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: رَأَيْتُ عَنَ يَمِينِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَشِمَالِهِ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ رَجُلَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا ثِيَابٌ بَيَاضٌ مَا رَأَيْتُهُمَا قَبْلُ وَلَا بَعْدُ "
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us: 'Ubayd Allah b. Musa narrated to us: Mis'ar narrated to us, from Sa'd b. Ibrahim, from his father, from Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, who said:
entries.matn_en: "I saw, on the right and on the left of the Messenger of God ﷺ on the day of Uhud, two men wearing white garments, whom I had not seen before nor after."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 138
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «إِنَّ هَذَا الْوَجَعَ - يَعْنِي الطَّاعُونَ - رِجْزٌ أُنْزِلَ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ فَإِذَا أَخَذَ بِأَرْضٍ وَلَسْتُمْ بِهَا فَلَا تَطَؤُهَا حَتَّى يَقْلَعَ عَنْهَا وَإِذَا أَخَذَ بِأَرْضٍ وَأَنْتُمْ بِهَا فَلَا تَخْرُجُوا مِنْهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us: 'Amr b. 'Awn narrated to us: Khalid b. 'Abd Allah informed us, from al-Shaybani, from Habib b. Abi Thabit, from Ibrahim b. Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, from his father, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "This affliction – meaning the plague – is a punishment (rijz) that was sent down upon those before you. So when it strikes a land and you are not in it, do not set foot in it until it lifts from it; and when it strikes a land and you are in it, do not leave it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 138
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ ، عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ ، عَنْ رِيَاحِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ
entries.matn_ar: مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us: 'Amr b. 'Awn narrated to us: Khalid narrated to us, from al-Shaybani, from Riyah b. 'Ubayda, from 'Amir b. Sa'd b. Malik,
entries.matn_en: the like of it.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 139
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ بُهْلُولٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ ، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ رُكَانَةَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَاهُ سَعْدَ بْنَ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: لَمَّا خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ إِلَى تَبُوكَ خَلَّفَ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ فَأَتَاهُ بِالْجُرُفِ يَحْمِلُ سِلَاحَهُ فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَتُخَلِّفُنِي بَعْدَكَ وَلَمْ أَتَخَلَّفْ عَنْكَ فِي غَزَاةٍ قَطُّ قَالَ: «يَا عَلِيُّ ارْجِعْ» ، فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: إِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ يَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّكَ مَا خَلَّفْتَنِي إِلَّا اسْتِثْقَالًا بِي قَالَ: «يَا عَلِيُّ أَمَا تَرْضَى أَنْ تَكُونَ مِنِّي بِمَنْزِلَةِ هَارُونَ مِنْ مُوسَى إِلَّا أَنَّهُ لَا نَبِيَّ بَعْدِي ، ارْجِعْ فَاخْلُفْنِي فِي أَهْلِي وَأَهْلِكَ» ، حَتَّى إِذَا سَارَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ رَجَعَ أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ فِي يَوْمٍ حَارٍّ فَوَجَدَ امْرَأَتَيْنِ لَهُ فِي عَرِيشَيْنِ لَهُمَا فِي حَائِطٍ قَدْ رَشَّتْ كُلُّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُمَا عَرِيشَهَا، وَقَدْ بَرَّدَتْ لَهُ فِيهِ مَاءً، وَهَيَّأَتْ لَهُ طَعَامًا فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ قَالَ: رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي الضِّحِّ وَالرِّيحِ، وَالْحَرِّ، وَأَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ فِي ظِلٍّ بَارِدٍ، وَمَاءٍ بَارِدٍ، وَطَعَامٍ مُهَيَّأٍ، وَامْرَأَةٍ حَسْنَاءَ فِي مَالِهِ مُقِيمٌ، مَا هَذَا بِالنَّصَفِ وَاللَّهِ لَا أَدْخُلُ عَرِيشَ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْكُمَا حَتَّى أَلْحَقَ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَهَيِّئا لِي زَادًا فَفَعَلَتَا ثُمَّ قَدِمَ نَاضِحَهُ فَارْتَحَلَ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ فِي طَلَبِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَتَّى أَدْرَكَهُ حِينَ نَزَلَ تَبُوكَ وَقَدْ كَانَ أَدْرَكَ أَبَا خَيْثَمَةَ عُمَيْرُ بْنُ وَهْبٍ الْجُمَحِيُّ يَطْلُبُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَتَرَافَقَا حَتَّى إِذَا دَنَوْا مِنْ تَبُوكَ قَالَ لِعُمَيْرٍ: إِنَّ لِي ذَنْبًا فَلَا عَلَيْكَ أَنْ تَخَلَّفَ عَنِّي حَتَّى أَقْدُمَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَسَارَ حَتَّى انْتَهَى إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَهُوَ نَازِلٌ بِتَبُوكَ فَلَمَّا طَلَعَ قَالَ النَّاسُ: هَذَا رَاكِبٌ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «كُنْ أَبَا خَيْثَمَةَ» ، فَمَا تَأَمَّلَهُ الْقَوْمُ قَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ فَلَمَّا أَنَاخَ سَلَّمَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «أَوْلَى لَكَ أَبَا خَيْثَمَةَ» ، فَقَصَّ عَلَيْهِ خَبَرَهُ فَدَعَا لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِخَيْرٍ وَقَالَ لَهُ خَيْرًا . وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ حِينَ خَرَجَ سَائِرًا وَهُوَ بِالْحِجْرِ فَلَمَّا نَزَلَهَا وَاسْتَقَى النَّاسُ مِنْ بِئْرِهَا أَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ حِينَ رَاحَ مِنْهَا أَنْ لَا يَشْرَبُوا مِنْ مَائِهَا شَيْئًا وَلَا يُتَوَضَّأَ مِنْهُ وَمَا كَانَ مِنْ عَجِينٍ عَجَنُوهُ أَنْ يَعْلِفُوهُ الْإِبِلَ وَنَهَى النَّاسَ عَنْ أَكْلِهِ، وَقَالَ: «لَا يَخْرُجَنَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمُ اللَّيْلَةَ إِلَّا وَمَعَهُ صَاحِبٌ» ، فَلَمَّا أَمْسَى النَّاسُ فَعَلُوا مَا أَمَرَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَخَرَجَ رَجُلَانِ مِنْ بَنِي سَاعِدَةَ أَمَّا أَحَدُهُمَا فَذَهَبَ لِحَاجَتِهِ وَأَمَّا الْآخَرُ فَذَهَبَ فِي طَلَبِ بَعِيرٍ لَهُ فَأَمَّا الَّذِي ذَهَبَ لِحَاجَتِهِ فَخُنِقَ عَلَى مَذْهَبِهِ وَأَمَّا الَّذِي ذَهَبَ فِي طَلَبِ بَعِيرِهِ فَاحْتَمَلَتْهُ الرِّيحُ حَتَّى طَرَحَتْهُ فِي جَبَلِ طَيِّئٍ فَأُخْبِرَ بِذَلِكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ: «أَلَمْ أَنْهَكُمْ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ رَجُلٌ إِلَّا وَمَعَهُ صَاحِبُهُ» ، فَدَعَا لِلَّذِي أُصِيبَ عَلَى مَذْهَبِهِ فَشُفِيَ فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْمَدِينَةَ أَهْدَتْ لَهُ طَيِّئٌ الرَّجُلَ الَّذِي كَانَ وَقَعَ بَيْنَ أَظْهُرِهِمْ فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ النَّاسُ وَلَا مَاءَ مَعَهُمْ ذَكَرُوا لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَدَعَا فَأَرْسَلَ اللَّهُ سَحَابَةً فَأَمْطَرَتْ حَتَّى ارْتَوَوُا النَّاسُ وَاحْتَمَلُوا حَاجَتَهُمْ
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us: Yusuf b. Buhlul narrated to us: 'Abd Allah b. Idris narrated to us, from Muhammad b. Ishaq: Muhammad b. Talha b. Yazid b. Rukana narrated to me, from Ibrahim b. Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, that he heard his father Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas say:
entries.matn_en: When the Messenger of God ﷺ set out from Medina for Tabuk, he left 'Ali b. Abi Talib behind. [‘Ali] came to him at al-Jurf, carrying his weapons, and said: "O Messenger of God, are you leaving me behind after you, when I have never stayed behind from you in any campaign?" He said: "'Ali, go back." He said: "O Messenger of God, the hypocrites claim that you left me behind only because you found me a burden." He said: "'Ali, are you not pleased to be to me as Aaron was to Moses, except that there is no prophet after me? Go back and be my successor among my family and yours." Then, when the Messenger of God ﷺ had set off, Abu Khaythama returned one day to his family, on a hot day, and found his two wives in two arbours of theirs in an orchard; each of them had sprinkled her arbour with water, had cooled water for him in it, and had prepared food for him. When he entered he said: "The Messenger of God ﷺ is out in the blazing sun, the wind and the heat, while Abu Khaythama is in cool shade, with cool water, prepared food and a beautiful woman, staying in his own property! By God, this is not just. I will not enter the arbour of either of you until I join the Messenger of God ﷺ. So prepare provisions for me." They did so. Then he brought forward his water-camel, saddled it, and set out in search of the Messenger of God ﷺ until he caught up with him as he alighted at Tabuk. 'Umayr b. Wahb al-Jumahi had caught up with Abu Khaythama while he too was seeking the Messenger of God ﷺ and the two travelled together, until, when they drew near Tabuk, [Abu Khaythama] said to 'Umayr: "I have a sin [to answer for], so it is no matter if you hang back behind me until I reach the Messenger of God ﷺ." So he rode on until he reached the Messenger of God ﷺ who was camped at Tabuk. When he appeared the people said: "A rider!" The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "Be Abu Khaythama!" When the people looked closely they said: "O Messenger of God, it is Abu Khaythama!" When he made his camel kneel he greeted the Messenger of God ﷺ who said to him: "Awla laka, Abu Khaythama!" [an idiom of reproach, roughly: "You came close to ruin!"]. He recounted his story to him, and the Messenger of God ﷺ prayed for good for him and spoke well to him. And when the Messenger of God ﷺ set out, he was at al-Hijr; when he alighted there and the people drew water from its well, then, as he departed from it, the Messenger of God ﷺ commanded that they not drink any of its water, nor perform ablution with it, and that any dough they had kneaded be fed to the camels; and he forbade the people to eat it. He said: "Let none of you go out tonight except with a companion." When evening came the people did as the Messenger of God ﷺ had commanded them. Two men of the Banu Sa'ida went out: one of them went for his need, and the other went in search of a camel of his. The one who went for his need was choked on his way; the one who went in search of his camel was carried off by the wind, which cast him down on the mountain of Tayyi'. The Messenger of God ﷺ was told of that and said: "Did I not forbid you that any man go out except with his companion?" He prayed for the one who had been struck on his way, and he was healed. When the Messenger of God ﷺ came to Medina, Tayyi' sent him as a gift the man who had fallen among them. And when morning came and the people had no water, they mentioned it to the Messenger of God ﷺ; he prayed, and God sent a cloud, which rained until the people were watered and took away what they needed.

sections.title_en: Muhammad b. Sa'd, from his father

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 142
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزُ بْنُ أَسَدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: «لَأَنْ يَمْتَلِئَ جَوْفُ أَحَدِكُمْ قَيْحًا وَدَمًا خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ يَمْتَلِئَ شِعْرًا»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us: Bahz b. Asad narrated to us: Shu'ba narrated to us: Qatada narrated to us, from Yunus b. Jubayr, from Muhammad b. Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, from his father,
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: "For the belly of one of you to be filled with pus and blood is better than for it to be filled with poetry."

sections.title_en: Yahya b. Sa'd, from his father

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 144
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعْدٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: «إِذَا كَانَ الطَّاعُونُ بِأَرْضٍ وَأَنْتُمْ بِهَا فَلَا تَخْرُجُوا مِنْهَا فَإِذَا كَانَ بِأَرْضٍ وَلَسْتُمْ بِهَا فَلَا تَدْخُلُوهَا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Samad b. 'Abd al-Warith narrated to us: Hammam narrated to us: Qatada narrated to us, from 'Ikrima b. Khalid, from Yahya b. Sa'd, from his father,
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: "When the plague is in a land and you are in it, do not leave it; and when it is in a land and you are not in it, do not enter it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 145
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمُ بْنُ حَبَّانَ ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ ، حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعْدٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: ذُكِرَ الطَّاعُونُ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ: «إِنَّهُ رِجْزٌ أُصِيبَ بِهِ مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ فَإِذَا كَانَ بِأَرْضٍ فَلَا تَدْخُلُوهَا وَإِنْ كَانَ بِهَا وَأَنْتُمْ بِهَا فَلَا تَخْرُجُوا مِنْهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us: 'Affan b. Muslim narrated to us: Sulaym b. Hayyan narrated to us: 'Ikrima b. Khalid narrated to us: Yahya b. Sa'd narrated to me, from his father, who said:
entries.matn_en: The plague was mentioned in the presence of the Messenger of God ﷺ and he said: "It is a punishment (rijz) with which those before you were afflicted. So when it is in a land, do not enter it; and if it is in it while you are in it, do not leave it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 146
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْقُرَشِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ النَّضْرِ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَامِرُ بْنُ خَارِجَةَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ سَعْدٍ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ قَوْمًا أَتَوُا النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَشَكَوْا قَحْطَ الْمَطَرَ فَأَمَرَهُمُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ أَنْ يَجْثُوا عَلَى رُكَبِهِمْ وَيَقُولُوا: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ وَأَشَارَ بِأُصْبُعِهِ قَالَ: فَسَقَوْا حَتَّى أَحَبُّوا أَنْ يُكْشَفَ عَنْهُمْ
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us: 'Ubayd Allah b. Muhammad al-Qurashi narrated to us: Hafs b. al-Nadr narrated to us: 'Amir b. Kharija b. Sa'd narrated to us, from his grandfather Sa'd,
entries.matn_en: that some people came to the Prophet ﷺ and complained of the withholding of rain, so the Prophet ﷺ commanded them to kneel on their knees and say: "O Lord, O Lord," and he pointed with his finger. He said: They were given rain until they wished it would be lifted from them.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 147
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا مَكِّيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، حَدَّثَنَا جُعَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ بِنْتِ سَعْدٍ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ أَبَاهَا قَالَ: اشْتَكَيْتُ بِمَكَّةَ شَكْوَى شَدِيدَةً فَجَاءَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَعُودُنِي فَقُلْتُ: يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ إِنِّي تَرَكْتُ مَالًا وَإِنِّي لَمْ أَتْرُكْ إِلَّا ابْنَةً وَاحِدَةً فَأُوصِي بِثُلُثَيْ مَالِي وَأَتْرُكُ الثُّلُثَ؟ فَقَالَ: «لَا» ، قُلْتُ: فَأُوصِي بِالنِّصْفِ وَأَتْرُكُ لَهَا النِّصْفَ؟ قَالَ: «لَا» ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: فَأُوصِي بِالثُّلُثِ وَأَتْرُكُ لَهَا الثُّلُثَيْنِ؟ فَقَالَ: «الثُّلُثُ وَالثُّلُثُ كَبِيرٌ أَوْ كَثِيرٌ» ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ وَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَى جَبْهَتِي ثُمَّ مَسَحَ وَجْهِي وَصَدْرِي وَبَطْنِي ثُمَّ قَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ اشْفِ سَعْدًا وَأَتْمِمْ لَهُ هِجْرَتَهُ» ، قَالَ: فَمَا زِلْتُ أَجِدُ بَرْدَ يَدِهِ عَلَى كَبِدِي فِيمَا يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيَّ حَتَّى السَّاعَةَ
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us: Makki b. Ibrahim narrated to us: Ju'ayd b. 'Abd al-Rahman narrated to us, from 'A'isha bint Sa'd,
entries.matn_en: that her father said: I fell gravely ill in Mecca, and the Messenger of God ﷺ came to visit me. I said: "O Prophet of God, I am leaving wealth, and I am leaving only one daughter; shall I bequeath two-thirds of my wealth and leave a third?" He said: "No." I said: "Shall I bequeath half and leave her half?" He said: "No." He said: I said: "Shall I bequeath a third and leave her two-thirds?" He said: "A third; and a third is large – or: much." He said: Then he placed his hand on my forehead and wiped my face, my chest and my belly, and then said: "O God, heal Sa'd and complete his emigration for him." He said: "And I have not ceased to feel the coolness of his hand upon my liver, as it seems to me, until this very hour."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 148
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ ، عَنِ ابْنَةٍ سَعْدٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهَا قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: " افْتَرَقَتْ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ عَلَى إِحْدَى وَسَبْعِينَ مِلَّةٍ وَلَا تَذْهَبُ اللَّيَالِي وَلَا الْأَيَّامُ حَتَّى تَفْتَرِقَ أُمَّتِي عَلَى مِثْلِهَا - أَوْ قَالَ: عَلَى مِثْلِ ذَلِكَ - كُلُّ فِرْقَةٍ فِي النَّارِ إِلَّا وَاحِدَةً وَهِيَ الْجَمَاعَةُ "
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us: Ahmad b. 'Abd Allah b. Yunus narrated to me: Abu Bakr b. 'Ayyash narrated to us, from Musa b. 'Ubayda, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Ubayda, from a daughter of Sa'd, from her father, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "The Children of Israel split into seventy-one sects, and the nights and days will not pass until my community splits into the like of it" – or he said: "the like of that" – "every sect in the Fire except one, and that is the Community (al-jama'a)."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 149
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ بِنْتَ سَعْدٍ تَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «أَبِي وَاللَّهِ الَّذِي جَمَعَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْأَبَوَيْنِ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us: Isma'il b. Ibrahim narrated to us, from Ayyub, who said: I heard 'A'isha bint Sa'd say:
entries.matn_en: "My father, by God, is the one for whom the Messenger of God ﷺ combined his two parents on the day of Uhud."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 150
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي مُوسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ ، أَنَّ سَعِيدَ بْنَ أَبِي هِلَالٍ حَدَّثَهُ ، عَنْ خُزَيْمَةَ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ بِنْتِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهَا
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ دَخَلَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَلَى امْرَأَةٍ وَبَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا نَوًى أَوْ حَصًى تُسَبِّحُ بِهِ فَقَالَ: " أُخْبِرُكِ بِمَا هُوَ أَيْسَرُ عَلَيْكِ مِنْ هَذَا أَوْ أَفْضَلُ قُولِي: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا هُوَ خَالِقٌ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ "
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us: 'Abd Allah b. Abi Musa narrated to me: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb narrated to us: 'Amr b. al-Harith informed me that Sa'id b. Abi Hilal narrated to him, from Khuzayma, from 'Aisha bint Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, from her father,
entries.matn_en: that he entered with the Messenger of God ﷺ upon a woman, and before her were date-stones or pebbles with which she was glorifying [God]. He said: "Shall I tell you of what is easier for you than this, or better? Say: 'Glory be to God as many as He created in the heaven; glory be to God as many as He created on the earth; glory be to God as many as what is between that; and glory be to God as many as what He is [yet] to create; and God is greatest, the like of that; and praise be to God, the like of that; and there is no god but God, the like of that; and there is no power and no strength except through God, the like of that.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 151
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، عَنْ صَالِحٍ مَوْلَى التَّوْأَمَةِ ، عَنْ بَعْضِ وَلَدِ سَعْدٍ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ سَعْدًا خَرَجَ فَرَأَى عَبِيدًا مِنْ عَبِيدِ الْمَدِينَةِ يَقْطَعُونَ مِنْ شَجَرِ الْمَدِينَةِ فَسَلَبَهُمْ مَتَاعَهُمْ فَجَاءُوا إِلَيْهِمْ إِلَى سَعْدٍ فَقَالُوا: إِنَّ غِلْمَانَكَ أَخَذُوا مَتَاعَ غِلْمَانِنَا فَمُرْهُمْ فَلْيَرُدُّوهُ عَلَيْنَا فَقَالَ: لَيْسَ غِلْمَانِي أَخَذُوهُ وَلَكِنِّي أَنَا أَخَذْتُهُ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ يَنْهَى عَنْ أَنْ يُقْطَعَ مِنْ شَجَرِ الْمَدِينَةِ وَقَالَ: «مَنْ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ فَلِمَنْ أَخَذَهُ سَلَبُهُ» ، فَهُوَ شَيْءٌ نَفَّلَنِيهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَمَا كُنْتُ لِأَرُدَّهُ وَلَكِنْ سَلُونِي مِنْ مَالِي
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us: Yazid b. Harun narrated to us: Ibn Abi Dhi'b informed us, from Salih, the freedman of al-Taw'ama, from some of Sa'd's children,
entries.matn_en: that Sa'd went out and saw some of the slaves of Medina cutting trees of Medina, and he stripped them of their belongings. They came to Sa'd and said: "Your boys took the belongings of our boys; command them to return them to us." He said: "It was not my boys who took it; rather, I took it. I heard the Messenger of God forbid the cutting of trees of Medina, and he said: 'Whoever does that, whoever catches him has his spoils.' So it is something the Messenger of God ﷺ granted me as spoil, and I will not return it; but ask me [for compensation] from my own wealth."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 152
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنِي يُوسُفُ بْنُ بُهْلُولٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ ، عَنِ ابْنِ إِسْحَاقَ ، حَدَّثَنِي صَالِحُ بْنُ كَيْسَانَ ، عَنْ بَعْضِ آلِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ سَعْدٌ يَقُولُ: وَاللَّهِ مَا حَرَصْتُ عَلَى قَتْلِ رَجُلٍ قَطُّ مَا حَرَصْتُ عَلَى قَتْلِ فُلَانٍ وَإِنْ كَانَ مَا عَلِمْتُ لَسَيِّئَ الْخُلُقِ مُبْغَضًا فِي قَوْمِهِ وَلَقَدْ كَفَانِي مِنْهُ قَوْلُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «اشْتَدَّ غَضَبُ اللَّهِ عَلَى مَنْ دَمَّى وَجْهَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ» ، وَقَدْ عَالَتْ عَالِيَةٌ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ الْجَبَلَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُ لَا يَنْبَغِي لَهُمْ أَنْ يَعْلُونَا» ، فَقَاتَلَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ وَرَهْطٌ مَعَهُ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ حَتَّى أَجْهَضُوهُمْ وَنَهَضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِلَى صَخْرَةٍ لِيَعْلُوهَا وَقَدْ كَانَ ظَاهَرَ بَيْنَ دِرْعَيْنِ فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ لِيَنْهَضَ فَلَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ أَنْ يَنْهَضَ فَجَلَسَ طَلْحَةُ تَحْتَهُ فَنَهَضَ فَجَلَسَ عَلَيْهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «أَوْجَبَ طَلْحَةُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us: Yusuf b. Buhlul narrated to me: 'Abd Allah b. Idris narrated to us, from Ibn Ishaq: Salih b. Kaysan narrated to me, from some of the family of Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, who said:
entries.matn_en: Sa'd used to say: "By God, I was never as eager to kill any man as I was to kill so-and-so, though – as far as I knew – he was ill-natured and hated among his people. And the saying of the Messenger of God ﷺ was enough for me regarding him: 'God's anger is intense against one who made the face of the Messenger of God ﷺ bleed.' And a high party of Quraysh climbed the mountain, and the Messenger of God ﷺ said: 'O God, it is not fitting that they be above us.' 'Umar b. al-Khattab and a group of the Emigrants with him fought until they drove them off. The Messenger of God ﷺ rose toward a rock to climb it – he having worn two coats of mail, one over the other – and when he went to rise, he was unable to, so Talha sat down beneath him and he rose, and the Messenger of God ﷺ sat upon it. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: 'Talha has made [Paradise] incumbent.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 154
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ صَاحِبُ الطَّيَالِسَةِ ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، أَخْبَرَنِي زِيَادُ بْنُ مِخْرَاقٍ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ قَيْسَ بْنَ عَبَايَةَ يُكْنَى أَبَا عَبَايَةَ يُحَدِّثُ ، عَنْ مَوْلًى لِسَعْدٍ:
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ سَعْدَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ سَمِعَ ابْنًا لَهُ يَقُولُ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَنَعِيمَهَا وَإِسْتَبْرَقَهَا وَحَرِيرَهَا وَنَحْوَ هَذَا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ وَسَلَاسِلَهَا وَأَغْلَالَهَا وَنَحْوَ هَذَا فَلَمَّا صَلَّى قَالَ سَعْدٌ: قَدْ سَأَلْتَ اللَّهَ خَيْرًا كَثِيرًا وَتَعَوَّذْتَ مِنْ شَرِّ عَظِيمٍ أَوْ قَالَ كَبِيرٍ وَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: " سَيَكُونُ قَوْمًا يَعْتَدُونَ فِي الدُّعَاءِ وَحَسْبُكَ أَنْ تَقُولَ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ " قَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ الْبَاهِلِيُّ: ثَبَّتَنِي فِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِنَا فِي قَوْلِهِ: مَوْلًى لِسَعْدٍ، وَقَالَ لِي هَذَا الرَّجُلُ: إِنَّ يَحْيَى بْنَ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانَ يَقُولُ: أَبُو نَعَامَةَ مَكَانَ أَبِي عَبَايَةَ، وَقَالَ غُنْدَرٌ: زَيْدٌ أَبُو عَبَايَةَ مَكَانَ قَيْسٍ
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us: Abu Dawud, the master of the shawls, narrated to us: Shu'ba informed us: Ziyad b. Mikhraq informed me; he said: I heard Qays b. 'Abaya, who is called Abu 'Abaya, narrate from a freedman of Sa'd:
entries.matn_en: that Sa'd b. Malik heard a son of his say: "O God, I ask You for Paradise and its bliss, its brocade and its silk," and the like of this, "and I seek refuge in You from the Fire, its chains and its shackles," and the like of this. When he had finished praying, Sa'd said: "You have asked God for much good and sought refuge from a great evil" – or he said: "a big one" – "and I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: 'There will be people who transgress in supplication. It is enough for you to say: O God, I ask You for Paradise and whatever brings one near to it of word or deed, and I seek refuge in You from the Fire and whatever brings one near to it of word or deed.'" Abu l-Hasan al-Bahili said: One of our associates confirmed for me, regarding this hadith, the phrase "a freedman of Sa'd", and this man told me that Yahya b. Sa'id al-Qattan says "Abu Na'ama" in place of "Abu 'Abaya", and Ghundar said "Zayd Abu 'Abaya" in place of "Qays."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 156
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي مُوسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو صَخْرٍ حُمَيْدُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ ، عَنِ ابْنٍ لِسَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «بَدَأَ الْإِسْلَامُ غَرِيبًا وَسَيَعُودُ كَمَا بَدَأَ وَطُوبَى يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْغُرَبَاءِ إِذَا فَسَدَ الزَّمَانُ وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ أَبِي الْقَاسِمِ بِيَدِهِ إِنَّ الْإِيمَانَ لَيَأْرِزُ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ كَمَا تَأْرِزُ الْحَيَّةُ إِلَى جُحْرِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us: 'Abd Allah b. Abi Musa narrated to us: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb narrated to us: Abu Sakhr Humayd b. Ziyad narrated to me, from Abu Hazim, from a son of Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, who said: I heard my father say:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "Islam began as a stranger and will return as it began, and blessed on that day are the strangers, when the times are corrupt. By Him in whose hand is the soul of Abu l-Qasim, faith will retreat to Medina as the snake retreats to its hole."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 164
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِنَّ الْإِسْلَامَ بَدَأَ غَرِيبًا، وَسَيَعُودُ غَرِيبًا، طُوبَى لِلْغُرَبَاءِ» ، قِيلَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَمَنِ الْغُرَبَاءُ؟ قَالَ: «النُّزَّاعُ مَنِ الْقَبَائِلِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad b. Ibrahim al-Dawraqi narrated to us; Umar b. Hafs narrated to us; my father narrated to me; al-A'mash narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu al-Ahwas, from Abd Allah, from the Prophet ﷺ:
entries.matn_en: ‘Islam began as something strange and will return to being strange. Blessed are the strangers.’ It was asked, ‘Messenger of God, who are the strangers?’ He said, ‘Those who withdraw from the tribes.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 165
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ الطَّائِفِيُّ ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ هُرْمُزٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " أَحَبُّ شَيْءٍ إِلَى اللَّهِ الْغُرَبَاءُ قَالَ: قِيلَ لَهُ: مَنِ الْغُرَبَاءِ؟ قَالَ: الْفَرَّارُونَ بِدِينِهِمْ يُجْمَعُونَ إِلَى عِيسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ "
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Abd al-Rahman b. Mahdi narrated to us; Muhammad b. Muslim al-Ta'ifi narrated to us, from Uthman b. Abd Allah b. Aws, from Sulayman b. Hurmuz, from Abd Allah b. Amr, who said:
entries.matn_en: ‘The most beloved people to God are the strangers.’ He was asked, ‘Who are the strangers?’ He said, ‘Those who flee with their religion; they will be gathered with Jesus son of Mary on the Day of Resurrection.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 166
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الدَّسْتُوَائِيُّ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ ، عَنِ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ بْنِ لَاحِقٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ سَعْدَ بْنَ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ عَنِ الطِّيَرَةِ فَانْتَهَرَنِي وَقَالَ: مَنْ حَدَّثَكَ فَكَرِهْتُ أَنْ أُحَدِّثَهُ مَنْ حَدَّثَنِي فَقَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «لَا عَدْوَى وَلَا طِيَرَةَ وَلَا هَامَ، إِنْ تَكُنِ الطِّيَرَةُ فِي شَيْءٍ فَفِي الْفَرَسِ وَالْمَرْأَةِ وَالدَّارِ وَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ بِالطَّاعُونِ بِأَرْضٍ فَلَا تَهْبِطُوا عَلَيْهِ وَإِذَا كَانَ بِأَرْضٍ وَأَنْتُمْ بِهَا فَلَا تَفِرُّوا مِنْهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Isma'il b. Ibrahim narrated to us; Hisham b. Abi Abd Allah al-Dastawa'i narrated to us, from Yahya b. Abi Kathir, from al-Hadrami b. Lahiq, from Sa'id b. al-Musayyib, who said:
entries.matn_en: I asked Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas about omens. He rebuked me and said, ‘Who told you?’ I disliked telling him who had told me. He then said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: ‘There is no contagion [that acts independently], no omen, and no hama. If an omen were to be found in anything, it would be in a horse, a woman, or a house. When you hear that plague is in a land, do not go down into it; and if it is in a land where you are, do not flee from it.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 168
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ ، أَخْبَرَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِكْرِمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ لَبِيبَةَ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنَّا نُكْرِي الْأَرْضَ بِمَا عَلَى السَّوَاقِي مِنَ الزَّرْعِ وَبِمَا يَسْعِدُ مِنَ الْمَاءِ فَنَهَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ ذَلِكَ وَأَمَرَنَا أَنْ نُكْرِيَهَا بِذَهَبٍ أَوْ وَرِقٍ
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Yazid b. Harun narrated to us; Ibrahim b. Sa'd informed me; Muhammad b. Ikrima b. Abd al-Rahman b. al-Harith b. Hisham informed me, from Muhammad b. Abd al-Rahman b. Labiba, from Sa'id b. al-Musayyib, from Sa'd b. Malik, who said:
entries.matn_en: We used to lease land for the crops along its irrigation channels and for the water that reached it. The Messenger of God ﷺ forbade us from doing that and instructed us to lease it for gold or silver.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 170
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ سَعْدَ بْنَ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ يُحَدِّثُ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ جَمَعَ لَهُ أَبَوَيْهِ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Abd Allah b. Numayr narrated to us, from Yahya b. Sa'id, from Sa'id b. al-Musayyib, who said: I heard Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas relate
entries.matn_en: that on the day of Uhud the Messenger of God ﷺ said to him, ‘Shoot! May my father and mother be your ransom.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 172
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَدْرٍ شُجَاعُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ السَّكُونِيُّ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ هَاشِمَ بْنَ هَاشِمٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَا أَسْلَمَ أَحَدٌ فِي الْيَوْمِ الَّذِي أَسْلَمْتُ فِيهِ، وَلَقَدْ مَكَثْتُ سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ وَإِنِّي لَثُلُثُ الْإِسْلَامِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Abu Badr Shuja b. al-Walid b. Qays al-Sakuni said: I heard Hashim b. Hashim, from Sa'id b. al-Musayyib, from Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, who said:
entries.matn_en: ‘No one became Muslim on the day I became Muslim. For seven days I remained a third of Islam.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 173
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا مَكِّيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ هَاشِمٍ الزُّهْرِيُّ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَا أَسْلَمَ أَحَدٌ فِي الْيَوْمِ الَّذِي أَسْلَمْتُ فِيهِ، وَلَقَدْ مَكَثْتُ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ ثُلُثَ الْإِسْلَامِ مَا أَسْلَمَ أَحَدٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Makki b. Ibrahim narrated to us; Hashim b. Hashim al-Zuhri narrated to us, from Sa'id b. al-Musayyib, from Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, who said:
entries.matn_en: ‘No one became Muslim on the day I became Muslim. For seven nights I remained a third of Islam; no one else had become Muslim.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 174
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو ظُفُرٍ عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ بْنُ مُطَهَّرٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ ، عَنْ حَرْبِ بْنِ شَدَّادٍ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: لَمَّا غَزَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ غَزْوَةَ تَبُوكَ خَلَّفَ عَلِيًّا بِالْمَدِينَةِ فَقَالُوا فِيهِ: مَلَّهُ وَكَرِهَ صُحْبَتَهُ فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ عَلِيًّا فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ ﷺ حَتَّى لَحِقَهُ فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ خَلَّفْتَنِي بِالْمَدِينَةِ مَعَ الذَّرَارِي وَالنِّسَاءِ حَتَّى قَالُوا: مَلَّهُ وَكَرِهَ صُحْبَتَهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «يَا عَلِيُّ إِنَّمَا خَلَّفْتُكَ عَلَى أَهْلِي أَمَا تَرْضَى يَا عَلِيُّ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِنِّي بِمَنْزِلَةِ هَارُونَ مِنْ مُوسَى إِلَّا أَنَّهُ لَا نَبِيَّ بَعْدِي»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Abu Zufar Abd al-Salam b. Mutahhar narrated to us; Ja'far b. Sulayman narrated to us, from Harb b. Shaddad, from Qatada, from Sa'id b. al-Musayyib, from Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, who said:
entries.matn_en: When the Messenger of God ﷺ went on the expedition to Tabuk, he left Ali behind in Medina. People spoke about him, saying that he had grown tired of him and disliked his company. This reached Ali, so he caught up with the Prophet ﷺ and said, ‘Messenger of God, you left me behind in Medina among the children and women, until people said that you had grown tired of me and disliked my company.’ The Messenger of God ﷺ said, ‘Ali, I left you in charge of my family. Are you not content, Ali, to have the same standing with me as Aaron had with Moses, except that there is no prophet after me?’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 176
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ زَيْدٍ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيِّبِ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قُلْتُ لِسَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ إِنَّ فِيكَ حِدَةً ، حَدَّثَنِي بِقَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِي عَلِيٍّ قَالَ: نَعَمْ ، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي عَلِيٍّ: «أَنْتَ مِنِّي بِمَنْزِلَةِ هَارُونَ مِنْ مُوسَى»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Abu Dawud narrated to us; Shu'ba narrated to us; Ali b. Zayd informed me, saying: I heard Sa'id b. al-Musayyib say:
entries.matn_en: I said to Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, ‘There is some severity in you; tell me what the Prophet ﷺ said about Ali.’ He said, ‘Yes.’ The Messenger of God ﷺ said to Ali: ‘You are to me as Aaron was to Moses.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 177
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ الْمِنْقَرِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، أنا عَلِيُّ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قُلْتُ لِسَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ: إِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ عَنْ شَيْءٍ وَإِنِّي أَهَابُكَ قَالَ: فَقَالَ: لَا يَا ابْنَ أَخِي إِذَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ عِنْدِي عِلْمًا فَسَلْنِي عَنْهُ وَلَا تَهَابَنِي، فَقُلْتُ: قَوْلُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ لِعَلِيٍّ فِي غَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ حِينَ خَلَّفَهُ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ، فَقَالَ سَعْدٌ: خَلَّفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ فِي غَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَتُخَلِّفُنِي فِي النِّسَاءِ وَالصِّبْيَانِ؟ فَقَالَ: «يَا عَلِيُّ أَلَا تَرْضَى أَنْ تَكُونَ مِنِّي بِمَنْزِلَةِ هَارُونَ مِنْ مُوسَى» ، قَالَ عَلِيُّ: بَلَى فَرَجَعَ عَلِيٌّ مُسْرِعًا كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى غُبَارِ قَدَمَيْهِ يَسْطَعُ
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Musa b. Isma'il al-Minqarī narrated to us; Hammad b. Salama narrated to us; Ali b. Zayd informed us, from Sa'id b. al-Musayyib, who said:
entries.matn_en: I said to Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, ‘I want to ask you something, but I feel apprehensive of you.’ He replied, ‘No, my nephew. If you know that I have knowledge of something, ask me; do not be apprehensive.’ I said, ‘What did the Messenger of God ﷺ say to Ali during the expedition of Tabuk, when he left him in Medina?’ Sa'd said: The Messenger of God ﷺ left Ali b. Abi Talib in Medina during the expedition of Tabuk. Ali said, ‘Messenger of God, are you leaving me among the women and children?’ He replied, ‘Ali, are you not content to have the same standing with me as Aaron had with Moses?’ Ali said, ‘Indeed.’ Then Ali hurried back; it is as though I can see the dust from his feet rising.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 178
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْغَفَّارِ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ: مَنْ أَنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: «أَنْتَ سَعْدُ بْنُ مَالِكِ بْنِ أُهَيْبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ مَنَافِ بْنِ زُهْرَةَ، مَنْ قَالَ غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ فَعَلَيْهِ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Abd Allah b. Abd al-Ghaffar narrated to us; Sufyan b. Uyayna narrated to us, from Ali b. Zayd, from Sa'id b. al-Musayyib, from Sa'd,
entries.matn_en: who said to the Messenger of God ﷺ, ‘Who am I, Messenger of God?’ He replied, ‘You are Sa'd b. Malik b. Uhayb b. Abd Manaf b. Zuhra. Whoever says otherwise, upon him is God's curse.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 179
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ الْحِزَامِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ التَّيْمِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سُهَيْلِ بْنُ مَالِكٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِسُوقِ الْخَيْلِ فَطَلَعَ الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «هَذَا الْعَبَّاسُ عَمُّ نَبِيِّكُمْ أَجْوَدُ قُرَيْشٍ كَفًّا وَأَوْصَلُهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Ibrahim b. al-Mundhir al-Hizami narrated to me; Muhammad b. Talha al-Taymi narrated to us; Abu Suhayl b. Malik narrated to us; Sa'id b. al-Musayyib narrated to us, from Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, who said:
entries.matn_en: We were with the Messenger of God ﷺ at the horse market when al-Abbas b. Abd al-Muttalib appeared. The Messenger of God ﷺ said, ‘This is al-Abbas, the uncle of your Prophet: Quraysh's most open-handed man and the one who most upholds kinship.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 180
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ الْبَاهِلِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُسَافِرٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ التَّيْمِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سُهَيْلِ بْنُ مَالِكٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِسُوقِ الْخَيْلِ فَذَكَرَ مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Abu al-Hasan al-Bahili said: Ja'far b. Musafir narrated this report to us; Muhammad b. Talha al-Taymi narrated to us; Abu Suhayl b. Malik narrated to us, from Sa'id b. al-Musayyib, from Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, who said:
entries.matn_en: We were with the Messenger of God ﷺ at the horse market, and he mentioned the like of the preceding report.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 181
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ ، حَدَّثَنَا وَرْقَاءُ ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ ، عَنِ الْأَعْرَجِ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ: رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «الْعَبَّاسُ عَمُّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِنَّ عَمَّ الرَّجُلِ صِنْوُ أَبِيهِ أَوْ صِنْوٌ مِنْ أَبِيهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Shababa narrated to us; Warqa narrated to us, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurayra, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said, ‘Al-Abbas is the uncle of the Messenger of God ﷺ. A man's paternal uncle is of the same stock as his father—or a branch of his father.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 182
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ صَاحِبُ الطَّيَالِسَةِ ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَقَدْ رَدَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَلَى عُثْمَانَ بْنِ مَظْعُونٍ التَّبَتُّلَ وَلَوْ أَذِنَ لَهُ فِي ذَلِكَ لَاخْتَصَيْنَا»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Abu Dawud, the author of the Musnad al-Tayalisi, narrated to us; Ibrahim b. Sa'd narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id b. al-Musayyib, from Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ refused Uthman b. Maz'un permission for celibacy. Had he given him permission for it, we would have castrated ourselves.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 184
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَجْلَانَ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْأَشَجِّ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ، عَنْ خَوْلَةَ بِنْتِ حَكِيمٍ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ: «لَوْ أَنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ إِذَا نَزَلَ مَنْزِلًا قَالَ أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ كُلِّهَا مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ لَمْ يَضُرَّهُ فِي ذَلِكَ الْمَنْزِلِ شَيْءٌ حَتَّى يَرْتَحِلَ مِنْهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Affan b. Muslim narrated to us; Wuhayb narrated to us; Muhammad b. Ajlan narrated to us, from Ya'qub b. Abd Allah b. al-Ashajj, from Sa'id b. al-Musayyib, from Sa'd b. Malik, from Khawla bint Hakim,
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet ﷺ said: ‘When one of you stops at a place and says, “I seek refuge in the perfect words of God, all of them, from the evil of what He has created,” nothing will harm him at that place until he departs from it.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 185
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ ، عَنْ خَوْلَةَ بِنْتِ حَكِيمٍ السُّلَمِيَّةِ ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَنْ نَزَلَ مَنْزِلًا فَقَالَ أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ لَمْ يَضُرَّهُ شَيْءٌ حَتَّى يَرْتَحِلَ مِنْ مَنْزِلِهِ ذَلِكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Qutayba b. Sa'id said: al-Layth b. Sa'd narrated to us, from Yazid b. Abi Habib, from al-Harith b. Ya'qub, from Ya'qub b. Abd Allah, from Busr b. Sa'id, from Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, from Khawla bint Hakim al-Sulamiyya, from the Messenger of God ﷺ, that he said:
entries.matn_en: ‘Whoever stops at a place and says, “I seek refuge in the perfect words of God from the evil of what He has created,” nothing will harm him until he departs from that place.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 186
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عِكْرِمَةَ بْنَ خَالِدٍ الْمَخْزُومِيَّ يُحَدِّثُ ، عَنِ ابْنٍ لِسَعْدٍ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ فِي الطَّاعُونِ: «إِذَا كَانَ بِأَرْضٍ - يَعْنِي وَأَنْتُمْ - بِهَا فَلَا تَخْرُجُوا مِنْهَا وَإِذَا كَانَ بِأَرْضٍ وَلَسْتُمْ بِهَا فَلَا تَدْخُلُوهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Abu Dawud narrated to us; Shu'ba narrated to us, from Qatada, who said: I heard Ikrima b. Khalid al-Makhzumi relate, from a son of Sa'd, from Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas,
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ said concerning the plague: ‘If it is in a land—and you are there—do not leave it; and if it is in a land where you are not, do not enter it.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 187
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ ، عَنْ زَيْدِ أَبِي عَيَّاشٍ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ سَعْدًا سُئِلَ عَنِ الْبَيْضَاءِ بِالسُّلْتِ فَكَرِهَهُ وَقَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُسْأَلُ عَنِ الرُّطَبِ بِالتَّمْرِ فَقَالَ: «أَيَنْقُصُ الرُّطَبُ إِذَا يَبِسَ؟» قَالُوا: نَعَمْ قَالَ: «فَلَا إِذًا»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Abd al-Rahman b. Mahdi narrated to us, from Malik b. Anas, from Abd Allah b. Yazid, from Zayd Abu Ayyash,
entries.matn_en: that Sa'd was asked about selling white wheat for sult [a variety of barley] and he disapproved of it. He said: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ being asked about fresh dates exchanged for dried dates. He asked, ‘Do fresh dates lose weight when they dry?’ They said, ‘Yes.’ He said, ‘Then no.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 189
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى ، أَخْبَرَنَا شَقِيقُ بْنُ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ خَالِدِ بْنِ عُرْفُطَةَ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ أَتَى سَعْدَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ: بَلَغَنِي أَنَّكُمْ تُعْرَضُونَ عَلَى سَبِّ عَلِيٍّ بِالْكُوفَةِ فَهَلْ سَبَبْتَهُ؟ قُلْتُ: مَعَاذَ اللَّهِ قَالَ: وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ سَعْدٍ بِيَدِهِ لَقَدْ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقُولُ فِي عَلِيٍّ شَيْئًا ، لَوْ وُضِعَ الْمِنْشَارُ عَلَى مَفْرِقِ رَأْسِي مَا سَبَبْتُهُ أَبَدًا
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Ubayd Allah b. Musa narrated to us; Shaqiq b. Abi Abd Allah informed us, from Abu Bakr b. Khalid b. Arfata,
entries.matn_en: that he came to Sa'd b. Malik and said, ‘I have heard that in Kufa you are being pressured to insult Ali. Did you insult him?’ I said, ‘God forbid!’ He said, ‘By the One in whose hand is Sa'd's soul, I heard the Prophet ﷺ say something about Ali that would make me never insult him, even if a saw were placed across the crown of my head.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 190
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْفُضَيْلِ ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ السُّلَمِيِّ قَالَ: قَالَ سَعْدُ بْنُ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ:
entries.matn_ar: فِيَّ سُنَّ الثُّلُثُ مَرِضْتُ مَرَضًا شَدِيدًا عَادَنِي فِيهِ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَقَالَ لِي: «هَلْ أَوْصَيْتَ؟» قُلْتُ: نَعَمْ قَالَ: «كَيْفَ أَوْصَيْتَ؟» قُلْتُ: أَوْصَيْتُ بِمَالِي كُلِّهِ قَالَ: «فَمَا تَرَكْتُ لَوَرَثَتِكَ؟» قُلْتُ: إِنَّهُمْ أَغْنِيَاءُ قَالَ: «أَوْصِ بِالْعُشْرِ وَاتْرُكْ سَائِرَهُ لَوَرَثَتِكَ» ، قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي قَدْ تَرَكْتُ وَرَثَتِي بِخَيْرٍ إِنَّهُمْ أَغْنِيَاءُ فَمَا زَالَ يُنَاقِصُنِي حَتَّى قَالَ: «أَوْصِ بِالثُّلُثِ وَالثُّلُثُ كَثِيرٌ» قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ فَمِنْ ثَمَّ يَسْتَحِبُّونَ أَنْ يُنْقِصُونَ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Muhammad b. al-Fudayl narrated to us, from Ata b. al-Sa'ib, from Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Sulami, who said: Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas said:
entries.matn_en: I was the one for whom the one-third limit was established. I became gravely ill, and the Prophet ﷺ visited me. He asked, ‘Have you made a bequest?’ I said, ‘Yes.’ He asked, ‘How have you bequeathed?’ I said, ‘All my property.’ He asked, ‘Then what have you left for your heirs?’ I said, ‘They are well-off.’ He said, ‘Bequeath one-tenth and leave the rest to your heirs.’ I said, ‘Messenger of God, I have left my heirs well provided for; they are well-off.’ He continued reducing the amount for me until he said, ‘Bequeath one-third, and one-third is much.’ Abu Abd al-Rahman said: This is why they consider it recommended to bequeath less than one-third.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 192
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ الْأَحْوَلُ ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ سَعْدَ بْنَ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ شَيْئًا وَعَاهُ قَلْبِي مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «مَنِ ادَّعَى إِلَى غَيْرِ أَبِيهِ وَهُوَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ غَيْرُ أَبِيهِ فَالْجَنَّةُ عَلَيْهِ حَرَامٌ» ، قَالَ: فَلَقِيتُ أَبَا بَكْرَةَ فَحَدَّثْتُهُ فَقَالَ: وَأَنَا سَمِعَتْ أُذُنَايَ وَوَعَاهُ قَلْبِي مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Isma'il b. Ibrahim narrated to us; Asim al-Ahwal narrated to us, from Abu Uthman al-Nahdi, who said: I heard Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas say:
entries.matn_en: I heard something from the Messenger of God ﷺ that my heart retained from Muhammad ﷺ: ‘Whoever knowingly claims descent from someone other than his father, Paradise is forbidden to him.’ He said: I later met Abu Bakra and related it to him. He said, ‘My ears too heard it, and my heart retained it from Muhammad ﷺ.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 194
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ:
entries.matn_ar: «أَدْبَرَتْ فِتْنَةٌ الْقَاعِدُ فِيهَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْقَائِمِ وَالْقَائِمُ فِيهَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْمَاشِي وَالْمَاشِي فِيهَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ السَّاعِي وَالسَّاعِي فِيهَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْمُوضِعِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Ahmad b. Abd Allah b. Yunus narrated to us; Abu Shihab narrated to us, from Dawud b. Abi Hind, from Abu Uthman, from Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas:
entries.matn_en: ‘A tribulation has come to an end. The one sitting during it is better than the one standing; the one standing is better than the one walking; the one walking is better than the one hastening; and the one hastening is better than the one driving into it.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 195
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ أَبِي هِنْدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيُّ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «لَا تَزَالُ الْعَرَبُ ظَاهِرِينَ عَلَى الْحَقِّ حَتَّى تَقُومَ السَّاعَةُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Muhammad b. al-Sabbah narrated to us; Hushaym narrated to us; Dawud b. Abi Hind narrated to us; Abu Uthman al-Nahdi narrated to us, from Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: ‘The Arabs will continue to uphold the truth until the Hour is established.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 196
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ الْبَاهِلِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَكَمِ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى: {زَيْتُونَةٍ لَا شَرْقِيَّةٍ وَلَا غَرْبِيَّةٍ} [النور: 35] قَالَ: «هِيَ الشَّامُ الْعِرَاقُ شَرْقٌ، وَمِصْرُ غَرْبٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Muhammad al-Bahili narrated to us; Sa'd b. Abd Allah b. Abd al-Hakam narrated to us; my father narrated to us, from Malik,
entries.matn_en: concerning God's saying, ‘An olive tree neither eastern nor western’ [Qur'an 24:35]. He said: ‘Syria; Iraq is east, and Egypt is west.’ [This is a transmitted exegetical comment, not a Prophetic saying.]

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 197
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ مُعَاذٍ الْمَكِّيِّ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: " صَلَاتَانِ لَا صَلَاةَ بَعْدَهُمَا: الْعَصْرُ حَتَّى تَغْرُبَ الشَّمْسُ، وَالْفَجْرُ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ "
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Ibrahim b. Mahdi narrated to me; Ibrahim b. Sa'd narrated to us, from his father, from Mu'adh al-Makki, from Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: ‘There are two prayers after which there is no prayer: the afternoon prayer until the sun sets, and the dawn prayer until the sun rises.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 199
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ عَبْدُ رَبِّهِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ الْحَنَّاطُ ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «أُمِرْنَا إِذَا رَأَيْنَا الْغُولَ أَنْ نُنَادِيَ بِالصَّلَاةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Ahmad b. Abd Allah b. Yunus narrated to us; Abu Shihab Abd Rabbih b. Nafi al-Hannat informed us, from Yunus b. Ubayd, from al-Hasan, from Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, who said:
entries.matn_en: ‘We were instructed that, when we saw a ghoul, we should call the prayer.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 201
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ ، حَدَّثَنَا أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْقَرَّاظُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سَعْدَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ، وَأَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولَانِ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِأَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ فِي مَدِينَتِهِمْ، وَبَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِي صَاعِهِمْ، وَبَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِي مُدِّهِمُ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَبْدُكَ وَخَلِيلُكَ، وَإِنِّي عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ، وَإِنَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ سَأَلَكَ لِأَهْلِ مَكَّةَ، وَإِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ لِأَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ، مِثْلَ مَا سَأَلَكَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ لِأَهْلِ مَكَّةَ وَمِثْلَهُ مَعَهُ، إِنَّ الْمَدِينَةَ مُشَبَّكَةٌ بِالْمَلَائِكَةِ عَلَى كُلِّ نَقْبٍ مِنْهَا مَلَكَانِ يَحْرُسَانِهَا، لَا يَدْخُلُهَا الطَّاعُونُ وَلَا الدَّجَّالُ، فَمَنْ أَرَادَهَا بِسُوءٍ أَذَابَهُ اللَّهُ كَمَا يَذُوبُ الْمِلْحُ فِي الْمَاءِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Uthman b. Umar narrated to us; Usama b. Zayd narrated to us; Abu Abd Allah al-Quraz informed us that he heard Sa'd b. Malik and Abu Hurayra say:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: ‘O God, bless the people of Medina in their city; bless for them their saʿ and their mudd. O God, Abraham is Your servant and intimate friend, and I am Your servant and messenger. Abraham asked You on behalf of the people of Mecca, and I ask You on behalf of the people of Medina for the like of what Abraham asked You for the people of Mecca, and the like of it in addition. Medina is encircled by angels: at each of its passes are two angels guarding it. Neither plague nor the Dajjal will enter it. Whoever intends evil against it, God will melt him as salt melts in water.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 202
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا صَفْوَانُ بْنُ عِيسَى الزُّهْرِيُّ ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ نُبَيْهٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا دِينَارٌ الْقَرَّاظُ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «مَنْ أَرَادَ أَهْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ بِسُوءٍ أَذَابَهُ اللَّهُ إِذَابَةَ الْمِلْحِ فِي الْمَاءِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Safwan b. Isa al-Zuhri narrated to us, from Umar b. Nubayh; Dinar al-Quraz, Abu Abd Allah, narrated to us, from Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: ‘Whoever intends evil against the people of Medina, God will melt him as salt melts in water.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 203
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ يَعْلَى يُحَدِّثُ ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ سَعْدَ بْنَ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ
entries.matn_ar: - فَأَتَاهُ قَوْمٌ فِي عَبْدٍ لَهُمْ أَخَذَ سَعْدٌ سَلَبَهُ لِأَنَّهُ رَآهُ يَصِيدُ فِي حَرَمِ الْمَدِينَةِ الَّذِي حَرَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَكَلَّمُوهُ فِي أَنْ يَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِمْ سَلَبَ عَبْدِهِمْ - فَقَالَ: " لَنْ أَرُدَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ لِأَنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ حِينَ حَدَّ حُدُودَ حَرَمِ الْمَدِينَةِ -: مَنْ وَجَدْتُمُوهُ يَصِيدُ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْحُدُودِ فَمَنْ أَخَذَهُ فَلَهُ سَلَبُهُ فَلَا أَرُدُّ عَلَيْكُمْ طُعْمَةً أَطْعَمَنِيهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَلَكِنْ إِنْ شِئْتُمْ أَعْطَيْتُكُمْ ثَمَنَ سَلَبِهِ "
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Wahb b. Jarir b. Hazim narrated to us; my father narrated to us, saying: I heard Ya'la relate, from Sulayman b. Abi Abd Allah, who said: I heard Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas.
entries.matn_en: Some people came to him concerning a servant of theirs whose belongings Sa'd had taken after seeing him hunt within the sanctuary of Medina, which the Messenger of God ﷺ had declared sacred. They asked Sa'd to return the servant's belongings. He said, ‘I will not return them to you, because I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ, when he marked the boundaries of Medina's sanctuary, say: “Whoever you find hunting within any part of these boundaries, the one who catches him may take his belongings.” I will not return to you a provision the Messenger of God ﷺ gave me. But, if you wish, I will give you the value of his belongings.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 204
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنِي يُوسُفُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ السَّدُوسِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ التَّيْمِيُّ ، عَنْ غُنَيْمِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ سَعْدًا عَنِ الْمُتْعَةِ فَقَالَ: «فَعَلْنَاهَا وَهَذَا يَوْمَئِذٍ كَافِرٌ بِالْعَرْشِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Yusuf b. Ya'qub al-Sadusi narrated to me; Sulayman al-Taymi narrated to us, from Ghunaym b. Qays, who said:
entries.matn_en: I asked Sa'd about mutʿa [temporary marriage]. He said: ‘We practiced it, while this man was then an unbeliever in the Lord of the Throne.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 206
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ نَوْفَلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ أَنَّهُ حَدَّثَهُ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سَعْدَ بْنَ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ وَالضَّحَّاكَ بْنَ سُفْيَانَ عَامَ حَجِّ مُعَاوِيَةَ وَهُمَا يَذْكُرَانِ التَّمَتُّعَ بِالْعُمْرَةِ إِلَى الْحَجِّ فَقَالَ الضَّحَّاكُ: لَا يَصْنَعُ ذَلِكَ إِلَّا مَنْ جَهِلَ أَمْرَ اللَّهِ ، فَقَالَ سَعْدٌ: بِئْسَ مَا قُلْتَ يَا أَخِي ، فَقَالَ الضَّحَّاكُ: فَإِنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ ﵁ قَدْ نَهَى عَنْ ذَلِكَ ، فَقَالَ سَعْدٌ: قَدْ صَنَعَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَصَنَعْنَاهَا بَعْدَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Rawh b. Ubada narrated to us; Malik narrated to us, from Ibn Shihab, from Muhammad b. Abd Allah b. al-Harith b. Nawfal b. Abd al-Muttalib, who related
entries.matn_en: that he heard Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas and al-Dahhak b. Sufyan, in the year Mu'awiya performed pilgrimage, discussing combining the lesser pilgrimage with the major pilgrimage. Al-Dahhak said, ‘Only someone ignorant of God's command does that.’ Sa'd said, ‘What a bad thing you have said, my brother!’ Al-Dahhak said, ‘Umar b. al-Khattab forbade it.’ Sa'd replied, ‘The Messenger of God ﷺ did it, and we did it after him.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 208
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْعَنْسِيُّ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ بَعَثَهُ إِلَى حَيٍّ مِنْ قَيْسٍ فَرَجَعَ إِلَيْهِ وَهُوَ يُكْثِرُ التَّكْبِيرَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «أَمَّا سَعْدٌ فَقَدْ رَأَى عَجَبًا» فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ جِئْتُكَ مِنْ عِنْدِ قَوْمٍ هُمْ وَأَنْعَامُهُمْ سَوَاءٌ إِنَّمَا هَمُّهُمْ مَا لَبِسُوا عَلَى ظُهُورِهِمْ وَأَكَلُوا فِي بُطُونِهِمْ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «يَا سَعْدُ أَفَلَا أُخْبِرُكَ بِأَعْجَبَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ قَوْمٌ عَلِمُوا مَا جَهِلَ هَؤُلَاءِ ثُمَّ جَهِلَ كَجَهْلِهِمْ» ، قَالَ: فَانْصَرَفَ سَعْدٌ فَقَالَ: يَا أَهَلَّاهُ هَلُمُّوا إِلَى بَيْعَةٍ فِي طَلَبِ نَعِيمٍ لَا يَزُولُ نَجْهَدُ أَنْفُسَنَا. قَالَ عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ: فَبَايَعُوهُ فَأَدْرَكْتُ عَجُوزًا شَهِدَتْ تِلْكَ الْبَيْعَةَ فَكُنَّا نَأْتِيهَا فَلَا تَكَادُ تَلْتَفِتُ اشْتِغَالٌا مِنْهَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Abd al-Rahman b. Abd Allah narrated to us; al-Walid b. Muslim narrated to us; Yazid b. Sa'id al-Ansi narrated to us, from Abd al-Malik b. Umayr, from Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas,
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ sent him to a clan of Qays. Sa'd returned to him repeatedly saying ‘God is Greatest.’ The Messenger of God ﷺ said, ‘As for Sa'd, he has seen something astonishing.’ Sa'd said, ‘Messenger of God, I have come from a people whose only concern is what they wear on their backs and eat in their bellies; they and their livestock are alike.’ The Messenger of God ﷺ said, ‘Shall I tell you of something more astonishing? A people who knew what these people were ignorant of, then became ignorant just as they were.’ Sa'd returned and said, ‘Come, my family, to a pledge in pursuit of a bliss that never fades; let us strive.’ Abd al-Malik said: They pledged allegiance to him. I later encountered an elderly woman who had witnessed that pledge. When we visited her, she would scarcely turn toward us, so absorbed was she in remembering God.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 209
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ الضَّرِيرُ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " مَرَّ عَلَيَّ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ وَأَنَا أَدْعُو بِأُصْبُعَيْنِ فَقَالَ: «أَحَدٌ أَحَدٌ وَأَشَارَ بِالسَّبَّابَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Abu Mu'awiya al-Darir narrated to us; al-A'mash narrated to us, from Abu Salih, from Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ passed by me while I was supplicating with two fingers. He said, ‘One—One,’ and pointed with his index finger.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 210
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ الْمَخْزُومِيُّ ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي نَهِيكٍ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ لَمْ يَتَغَنَّ بِالْقُرْآنِ» ، قَالَ وَكِيعٌ: يَسْتَغْنِي بِهِ
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Waki' narrated to us; Sa'id b. Hassan al-Makhzumi narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Mulayka, from Abd Allah b. Abi Nahik, from Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: ‘He is not one of us who does not recite the Qur'an melodiously.’ Waki' explained: ‘meaning, who does not find sufficiency in it.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 214
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُلَيْكِيُّ ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «اتْلُوا الْقُرْآنَ وَابْكُوا فَإِنْ لَمْ تَبْكُوا فَتَبَاكُوا لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ لَمْ يَتَغَنَّ بِالْقُرْآنِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Waki' narrated to us; Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Bakr al-Mulayki narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Mulayka, from Abd Allah b. al-Sa'ib, from Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: ‘Recite the Qur'an and weep. If you do not weep, then make yourselves weep. He is not one of us who does not recite the Qur'an melodiously.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 214
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ بْنِ أَبِي نَهِيكٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: جِئْتُ إِلَى سَعْدٍ فَقَالَ: مَنْ أَنْتَ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي؟ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ: مَرْحَبًا مَرْحَبًا تُجَّارُ كَسَبَةٍ كَيْفَ قِرَأَتُكَ الْيَوْمَ لِلْقُرْآنِ؟ قُلْتُ: حَسَنَةٌ قَالَ: فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: «اقْرَءُوا الْقُرْآنَ وَابْكُوا فَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدُوا بُكَاءً فَتَبَاكُوا» فَذَكَرَ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ وَكِيعٍ
entries.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to me; Ahmad narrated to us; Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Bakr b. Ubayd Allah b. Abi Mulayka narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Mulayka, from Abd Allah b. al-Sa'ib b. Abi Nahik, who said:
entries.matn_en: I came to Sa'd. He asked, ‘Who are you, my nephew?’ I told him, and he welcomed me, saying, ‘Welcome, welcome, merchants who earn their living! How is your recitation of the Qur'an today?’ I said, ‘Good.’ He said, ‘I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: “Recite the Qur'an and weep; if you cannot weep, then make yourselves weep.”’ Then he related a report like Waki's.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 215
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: دَخَلَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الْقَارِيُّ وَالْمُتَوَكِّلُ بْنُ أَبِي نَهِيكٍ عَلَى سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ فَقَالَ سَعْدٌ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو الْقَارِيِّ: مَنْ هَذَا؟ فَقَالَ: الْمُتَوَكِّلُ بْنُ أَبِي نَهِيكٍ قَالَ: نَعَمْ تُجَّارُ كَسَبَةٍ تُجَّارُ كَسَبَةٍ، سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: «لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ لَمْ يَتَغَنَّ بِالْقُرْآنِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Hajjaj b. Muhammad narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ata, who said:
entries.matn_en: Abd Allah b. Amr al-Qari and al-Mutawakkil b. Abi Nahik came to Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas. Sa'd asked Abd Allah b. Amr al-Qari, ‘Who is this?’ He replied, ‘Al-Mutawakkil b. Abi Nahik.’ Sa'd said, ‘Yes—merchants who earn their living, merchants who earn their living!’ I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: ‘He is not one of us who does not recite the Qur'an melodiously.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 216
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا خَلَفُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ الْأَزْدِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ زَكَرِيَّا بْنِ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ ، عَنْ مُجَالِدٍ ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ عِلَاقَةَ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: لَمَّا قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ الْمَدِينَةَ بَعَثَنَا فِي رَكْبٍ لَا يَكُونُ مِائَةً فَأَمَرَنَا أَنْ نُغِيرَ عَلَى حَيٍّ مِنْ كِنَانَةَ إِلَى جَنْبِ جُهَيْنَةَ وَكَانُوا كَثِيرًا فَلَجَأْنَا إِلَيْهِمْ فَمَنَعُونَا وَقَالُوا: لِمَ تُقَاتِلُونَنَا فِي الشَّهْرِ الْحَرَامِ؟ قُلْنَا: إِنَّمَا يُقَاتَلُ فِي الشَّهْرِ الْحَرَامِ مَنْ أَخْرَجْنَا مِنَ الْبَلَدِ الْحَرَامِ فِي الشَّهْرِ الْحَرَامِ قَالَ: وَكَانَ الْفَيْءُ إِذْ ذَاكَ مَنْ أَخَذَ شَيْئًا فَهُوَ لَهُ قَالَ: فَقَالَ بَعْضُنَا: نَأْتِي عَلَى عِيرِ قُرَيْشٍ فَنَقْتَطِعُهَا وَقَالَ بَعْضُنَا: بَلْ نُقِيمُ فِي مَكَانِنَا هَذَا فَقُلْتُ أَنَا فِي أُنَاسٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِي: بَلْ نَأْتِي رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَنُخْبِرُهُ قَالَ: فَأَتَيْنَاهُ فَقَامَ غَضْبَانُ فَقَالَ: «ذَهَبْتُمْ مِنْ عِنْدِي جَمِيعًا وَجِئْتُمْ مُتَفَرِّقِينَ لَأَبْعَثَنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ رَجُلًا لَيْسَ بِخَيْرِكُمْ، أَصْبَرُكُمْ عَلَى الْجُوعِ وَالْعَطَشِ فَبَعَثَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ جَحْشٍ وَكَانَ أَوَّلَ أَمِيرٍ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Khalaf b. al-Walid al-Azdi narrated to us; Yahya b. Zakariyya b. Abi Za'ida narrated to us, from Mujalid, from Ziyad b. Ilāqa, from Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, who said:
entries.matn_en: When the Prophet ﷺ arrived in Medina, he sent us out in a company numbering fewer than one hundred and ordered us to raid a clan of Kinana near Juhayna. They were numerous, so we took refuge with them. They prevented us and said, ‘Why are you fighting us in a sacred month?’ We replied, ‘The only ones fought in a sacred month are those who drove us from the Sacred Land during a sacred month.’ At that time, whatever spoils someone took belonged to him. Some of us said, ‘Let us intercept a Quraysh caravan’; others said, ‘Rather, let us stay here.’ I and a group of my companions said, ‘Rather, let us go to the Messenger of God ﷺ and inform him.’ We came to him, and he stood up angrily and said, ‘You left me all together and came back divided! I shall send over you a man who is not the best of you, but is the most patient of you in hunger and thirst.’ He then sent Abd Allah b. Jahsh, who was the first commander in Islam.

entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ الْمِنْقَرِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ ، حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ الثَّقَفِيُّ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: خَرَجَ نَاسٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكُوفَةِ فَطَعَنُوا عَلَى سَعْدٍ قَالَ: فَكَانَ مِنْ قَوْلِ الْعَبْسِيِّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: لَا يُحْسِنُ الصَّلَاةَ. فَغَضِبَ عُمَرُ غَضَبًا شَدِيدًا ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: كَيْفَ تُصَلِّي يَا سَعْدُ؟ قَالَ: " أُطِيلُ الْأُولَيَيْنِ وَأَحْذِفُ الْأُخْرَيَيْنِ حَذْفًا كَمَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَصْنَعُ ، قَالَ: فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: صَدَقْتَ قَالَ: فَلَمَّا رَأَى عُمَرُ قَدْ صَدَّقَهُ دَعَا عَلَيْهِ ، وَقَالَ: وَعَرِّضْهُ لِلْفِتَنِ. قَالَ: فَرَأَيْتُهُ يَتَزَوَّجُ الْيَهُودِيَّاتِ وَيَتَزَوَّجُ النِبْطِيَّاتِ "
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Musa b. Isma'il al-Minqarī narrated to us; Abd al-Wahid b. Ziyad narrated to us; al-Hasan narrated to us; Ubayd Allah b. Dinar al-Thaqafi narrated to me, who said:
entries.matn_en: Some people from Kufa went out and criticized Sa'd. One of the Banu Abs said, ‘He does not pray properly.’ Umar became very angry and then asked, ‘How do you pray, Sa'd?’ He said, ‘I lengthen the first two units and shorten the last two, just as I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ do.’ Umar said, ‘You have spoken the truth.’ When Umar saw that he had affirmed Sa'd, he [the narrator] invoked against the critic, saying, ‘Expose him to tribulations.’ He said: I later saw him marrying Jewish women and Nabatean women.

entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ الطُّفَاوِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ طَاوُسًا عَنْ رَجُلٍ رَمَى الْجَمْرَةَ بِسِتِّ حَصَيَاتٍ فَقَالَ: " يَتَصَدَّقُ بِقَبْضَةٍ مِنْ طَعَامٍ، قَالَ: فَلَقِيتُ مُجَاهِدًا فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ بِقَوْلِ طَاوُسٍ فَقَالَ: يَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَمَا سَمِعَ قَوْلَ سَعْدٍ: رَمَيْنَا الْجِمَارَ فِي حَجَّتِنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثُمَّ جَلَسْنَا نَتَذَاكَرُ فَمِنَّا مَنْ قَالَ: رَمَيْتُ بِسِتٍّ وَمِنَّا مَنْ قَالَ: رَمَيْتُ بِسَبْعٍ وَمِنَّا مَنْ قَالَ: رَمَيْتُ بِثَمَانٍ وَمِنَّا مَنْ قَالَ: رَمَيْتُ بِتِسْعٍ فَلَمْ يَرَوْا بِذَلِكَ بَأْسًا ، قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ: زِدْتُ حَسَنَةً وَنَقَصْتُ حَسَنَةً لَا بَأْسَ
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Abd al-Rahman b. al-Mubarak al-Tufawi narrated to us; Abd al-Warith b. Sa'id narrated to us; Abd Allah b. Abi Najih said:
entries.matn_en: I asked Tawus about a man who threw six pebbles at the stone pillars during pilgrimage. He said, ‘He should give a handful of food in charity.’ I later met Mujahid and asked him, telling him what Tawus had said. He replied, ‘May God have mercy on Abu Abd al-Rahman! Did he not hear Sa'd say: “We threw pebbles at the pillars during our pilgrimage with the Messenger of God ﷺ. Then we sat and discussed it. Some of us said, ‘I threw six’; some said, ‘I threw seven’; some said, ‘I threw eight’; and some said, ‘I threw nine.’ They saw no harm in that.”’ Ibn Abi Najih said: ‘I added one good deed and omitted one good deed; there is no harm.’

entries.citation: Musnad Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ · Vol. 1, p. 220
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، عَنِ السَّائِبِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «صَحِبْتُ سَعْدَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ إِلَى مَكَّةَ وَرَجَعْنَا فَمَا سَمِعْتُهُ يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ حَدِيثًا حَتَّى رَجَعْنَا»
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad narrated to us; Affan b. Muslim narrated to us; Hammad b. Zayd narrated to us; Yahya b. Sa'id narrated to me, from al-Sa'ib b. Yazid, who said:
entries.matn_en: I accompanied Sa'd b. Malik from Medina to Mecca and back, and I did not hear him relate a hadith from the Prophet ﷺ until we returned.
